jobs.name: download-vrt-shows
jobs.prompt:
Download VRT MAX shows (FC De Kampioenen, Flikken, Flikken Maastricht) using thuis.sh. This job runs hourly and will skip already-downloaded episodes. If a download fails (network error, server restart, etc.), it will be retried on the next hourly run.

Target URLs:
1. https://www.vrt.be/vrtmax/a-z/fc-de-kampioenen/ (all seasons)
2. https://www.vrt.be/vrtmax/a-z/flikken/ (all seasons)
3. https://www.vrt.be/vrtmax/a-z/flikken-maastricht/ (all seasons)

Output directory: /mnt/HDD1/nextcloud/data/aldo/files/Seed/media/tv/
Use --profile 1080 for 1080p quality.
The script handles retries automatically via the pre-download dedup check - already downloaded episodes are skipped.
